create.name: The Sati Center
create.bio:
Based in Redwood City, California, the Sati Center for Buddhist Studies is a non-profit set up to bring careful study of the Buddha's teachings together with meditation and with service in the wider world. Its outlook is mostly Theravada, though not only that, and it works closely with its neighbour, the Insight Meditation Center, while keeping its own board and programmes. Gil Fronsdal is part of its core faculty, together with a group of lay Dharma teachers and scholars.

Its offerings fall into two strands. One is textual and contemplative: short online series on the Pali suttas, the poems of the early nuns, renunciation and the Pali language, often offered on a donation basis, and a part-time certificate in Theravada Buddhist studies that runs over several years and includes a silent retreat. The other is applied: a year-long introduction to Buddhist chaplaincy, held in person in Redwood City or on Zoom, with eco-chaplaincy and spiritual care training alongside a monthly speaker series for chaplains. Many classes are recorded and shared freely through an online audio archive and a YouTube channel.

videos.title: To Be More Free, Reflect on Your Finitude (Maranasati) with Nikki Mirghafori

courses.title: Certificate in Theravada Buddhist Studies
courses.description: A part-time course of study lasting at least three years, built from units on ethics, meditation, the Eightfold Path and the suttas. Students also sit a week-long silent retreat as a practicum. Entry is by application and interview.

courses.title: Introduction to Buddhist Chaplaincy Training
courses.description: A year-long grounding in spiritual care shaped by Buddhist teaching, for people drawn to volunteer or professional chaplaincy. It runs in two separate groups, one in person in Redwood City and one on Zoom.

courses.title: Layers of Renunciation with Kim Allen
courses.description: Three weekly Zoom sessions on nekkhamma, the Pali idea usually translated as renunciation, and what it means for lay practitioners. Sessions mix sutta reading, reflection questions and meditation.

free_resources.title: Sati Center Class Recordings
free_resources.description: An audio archive of the centre's past classes, retreats and chaplaincy talks, free to stream. Recent series include sutta study and the poetry of the early Buddhist nuns.
